name: KPI / metric cards
description: Dashboard stat tiles with a label, a big number, and a trend delta coloured by direction.

name: Sortable data table
description: A zebra-striped table with sortable headers. Click a column header to re-sort.

name: Pricing billing toggle
description: A monthly / annual switch that swaps the displayed prices in place.

name: Spec / definition list
description: A two-column key/value sheet for technical specs, metadata, or property tables.

name: Horizontal bar chart
description: A lightweight, CSS-only comparison chart: labelled rows with proportional fills.

name: Activity feed / timeline
description: A vertical, dotted timeline of recent events with a relative timestamp and a type tag.
